text:
eng-release-manager: Heads-up: scheduling a gated enable for model skylark-7b-v3 in catalog at 02:00 UTC. Canary 4% ramping -> 25% over 45m. Fallback order set; see plan below. Post any objections now.
rachel: Ack from infra. Verified node pool quotas for eu-west and us-central.
tom: Added regional preference for eu-west and applied a soft-ttl for fallback decisions (60s). Will monitor autoscaler headroom.
deploybot: Plan created: deploy/enable-catalog/skylark-7b-v3 -> canary=4%@02:00, ramp=45m, monitor=10m, fallback_policy=ordered, soft_ttl=60s. Canary route: /models/skylark-canary
eng-release-manager: @oncall-sre please watch p95 and error-rate for first 20m. If p95 > 250ms for 5m or 5xx spikes >0.5% sustained 3m, trigger rollback.
oncall-sre: Setting alerts. Also enabling per-model trace sampling at 5% for the canary to help root cause.
zara: Note: skylark-7b-v3 enables mixed-precision quant fallback; expect slightly different tokenization latency. Watch per-token time.
rachel: Quick fallback policy snippet:
```
fallback_order:
  - model: "skylark-7b-v2"
    reason: "same arch, full-precision fallback"
  - model: "sparrow-6b-quant"
    reason: "low-cost fallback"
soft_ttl_seconds: 60
```
tom: Can we add a short dampening window for consecutive fallback triggers (2m) so we don't flip-flop during noisy spikes?
eng-release-manager: Good idea. Adding dampening_window=120s.
deploybot: Updated plan: dampening_window=120s applied.
oncall-sre: Dashboards live: token-latency-by-model, per-route error-rate, canary trace. I'll post links in 2m.
rachel: Smoke test against canary route passed. No obvious semantic drift in quick prompt tests.
tom: Starting canary at 02:00.
oncall-sre: 02:10 check-in: p95 190ms, 5xx at baseline. No action.
eng-release-manager: Ramping to 25% now per plan.
zara: Observed steady-state token throughput increase but no latency regressions.
oncall-sre: 02:40 small 0.6% 5xx blip for 90s on us-central, dampening prevented immediate fallback. We investigated: a transient infra throttling—resolved automatically.
tom: Because of the dampening window we did not cascade fallback. Good save.
eng-release-manager: Decision: continue ramp to full traffic after 00:30 UTC post-ramp validation. If anything crosses rollback thresholds we execute: 1) deploybot rollback 2) pin skylark-7b-v2 3) notify status page.
deploybot: Rollback hook name: deploybot.rollback_catalog_enable.skylark-7b-v3
rachel: Reminder: when pinning, update enterprise pinlist and notify account success for pinned customers.
eng-release-manager: Thanks team. I'll finalize release notes and tag release in GH. Posting post-mortem template in #postmortems if we see any issues. :rocket:
